comment: Budgets are gzip sizes in bytes. Set to (measured + 10%) at creation 2026-05-14, after countries-50m swap (PR #50). Categories: main-js = the initial bundle Vite emits as the largest index-*.js (loaded by dist/index.html). lazy-js = OTHER dynamically-imported JS chunks (today: topojson-client). Under Vite 8/Rolldown this is emitted as src-*.js; under Rollup it was a second index-*.js. Both are lazy-loaded via dynamic import. css = sum of all index-*.css. async-countries = the countries-*.js chunk (lazy-loaded via dynamic import). initial-total = main-js + css (the first-paint blocker). total-with-async = initial + async-countries + lazy-js (full bandwidth a session may use). Updating a budget upward requires a separate PR with measurement evidence.
